limitations: Extrema are exact over continuous axis-aligned boxes, not exact extrema of arbitrary discrete point subsets.
The census model starts from zero and queries one fixed pair at a time; joint endpoint-box traversal is only a proposal.
Integer arithmetic is unbounded Python arithmetic; no C++ overflow or performance qualification is transferred.
Saturated queries return no complete interior or shell payload; retained queries include all shell IDs.
The bounded model stores IDs in every tree node and expands accepted ID blocks before checking the cap; it is not a proposed production memory layout.
